name: Work Order Report
query:
SELECT
    wo.name AS "Work Order:Link/Facility Work Order:160",
    DATE(wo.creation) AS "Created Date:Date:105",
    wo.subject AS "Subject:Data:220",
    wo.work_order_type AS "Type:Data:90",
    wo.work_order_status AS "Status:Data:105",
    wo.priority AS "Priority:Link/Issue Priority:100",
    wo.category AS "Category:Link/Issue Type:140",

    wo.facility_location AS
        "Facility Location:Link/Facility Location:190",
    location.site AS "Site:Link/Site:130",
    location.building AS "Building:Link/Building:130",
    wo.asset AS "Asset:Link/Asset:150",

    wo.assignment_type AS "Assignment Type:Data:130",
    wo.technician AS "Technician:Link/Employee:150",
    wo.vendor AS
        "Service Provider:Link/Facility Service Provider:160",

    wo.planned_start AS "Planned Start:Datetime:145",
    wo.planned_end AS "Planned End:Datetime:145",
    wo.actual_start AS "Actual Start:Datetime:145",
    wo.actual_end AS "Actual End:Datetime:145",

    CASE
        WHEN wo.planned_end IS NOT NULL
             AND wo.planned_end < NOW()
             AND wo.work_order_status IN (
                 'Draft',
                 'Assigned',
                 'In Progress',
                 'Pending'
             )
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS "Overdue:Data:75",

    CASE
        WHEN wo.actual_start IS NOT NULL
             AND wo.actual_end IS NOT NULL
        THEN ROUND(
            TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                MINUTE,
                wo.actual_start,
                wo.actual_end
            ) / 60,
            2
        )
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Actual Duration (Hours):Float:140",

    COALESCE(labor.total_hours, 0)
        AS "Labor Hours:Float:100",

    wo.material_cost
        AS "Material Cost:Currency:115",

    wo.maintenance_request
        AS "Request:Link/Issue:140",

    wo.preventive_maintenance_plan
        AS "PM Plan:Link/Preventive Maintenance Plan:160"

FROM `tabFacility Work Order` wo

LEFT JOIN `tabFacility Location` location
    ON location.name = wo.facility_location

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent,
        SUM(hours) AS total_hours
    FROM `tabFacility Work Order Labor`
    WHERE parenttype = 'Facility Work Order'
    GROUP BY parent
) labor
    ON labor.parent = wo.name

WHERE
    DATE(wo.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

    AND wo.company = %(company)s

    AND (
        %(work_order_type)s = 'All'
        OR wo.work_order_type = %(work_order_type)s
    )

    AND (
        %(status)s = 'All'
        OR wo.work_order_status = %(status)s
    )

    AND (
        %(priority)s = 'All'
        OR wo.priority = %(priority)s
    )

    AND (
        %(assignment_type)s = 'All'
        OR wo.assignment_type = %(assignment_type)s
    )

ORDER BY
    wo.creation DESC
